entries.name: Andro-Eidos
entries.content: Biosynthetic beings created by Mother Sphere in order to annihilate the Alien occupation, and restore humanity to Terra. Having completed their mission, they have been retasked to become "Venus Units", and serve their human betters.

entries.name: Mother Sphere
entries.content:
A planet-sized super intelligence. 
Mother Sphere is a hyper-advanced sentient AI created by Raphael Marks in the year 2140, prior to the Final War. Created alongside the NETWORK in order to advance and evolve humanity. She governs and guides the space-faring human Colony, as well as the human remnant on Terra. She seeks the liberation of Earth from the Naytibas, and the restoration of Humanity, whom she loves dearly.

entries.name: Naytibas
entries.content: A mysterious alien race that invaded Earth at the end of the 22nd century. They chased humanity from their home planet, and nearly wiped out those that remain: only a few hundred thousand. The bulk of the humans remaining on Earth have sought refuge in XION: Humanity's last City. It is defended by the NETWORK, and a man named Orcal who has integrated himself with it.

entries.name: The Colony
entries.content: A massive space station, surrounded by carrier fleets and warships that were able to escape Earth before the Naytiba occupation was able to set up orbital defenses. They seek to reclaim Earth. They are unaware that any humans have survived on the planet's surface. Many Terrans believe that the Colony and Mother Sphere have abandoned them, though the faith of the believers seems to have been vindicated with the arrival of Mother Sphere's Angels.
